团队协作工具的产品设计笔记

这本笔记记录了我们团队在设计与迭代协作工具过程中的思考。中文段落应当保持原样，不被翻译引擎触碰；英文段落则应当被完整翻译成中文，两种语言在同页混排。

Remote collaboration changed the rhythm of engineering teams forever. Stand-up meetings became asynchronous threads, design reviews became recorded videos, and the office clock lost its meaning entirely. Teams that once measured engagement by visible presence now measure it by the quality of written artifacts.

中文段落的判定依赖字符区段统计：一段文字里汉字占比足够高，就会被识别为中文并跳过翻译。这与页面级的九成主导率跳过不同，是逐段进行的细粒度决策，不需要任何用户开关参与。

Written communication scales better than spoken conversation. A well-crafted design document can be read by a hundred engineers across time zones without a single meeting being scheduled. The document also archives the reasoning behind every decision, which new team members can read months later.

不过，异步协作也有代价。文字表达比口语更费力，误解更容易在字里行间积累。因此我们建议团队在重要决策上保留一次同步讨论的机会，再把结论沉淀成文档，两者结合效果最好。

Finally, tooling should disappear into the background. The best collaboration tools are the ones nobody praises in retrospectives, because they simply worked. Every minute a user spends fighting the tool is a minute stolen from the actual work the tool was purchased to support.

以上就是本篇笔记的全部内容。页面同时包含中文与英文段落，用于验证混合语言场景下的默认直翻行为：英文段落出现译文，中文段落保持原样且不带任何翻译包装节点。
